title: Better Aligned with Survey Respondents or Training Data? Unveiling Political Leanings of LLMs on U.S. Supreme Court Cases

bias_targets.methodology: Querying LLMs with multiple-choice survey questions based on 32 contentious U.S. Supreme Court cases (SCOPE dataset), assessing the political stance of relevant documents retrieved from pretraining corpora using zero-shot prompting, and utilizing Pearson correlation and Williams significance tests to measure alignment between the LLMs' preference distributions, human partisan survey responses, and the pretraining data.
